    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    def isbg(r, c): return 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and g[r][c] == bg
    blocks = [(r, c) for r in range(h-1) for c in range(w-1)
              if not isbg(r, c) and not isbg(r, c+1) and not isbg(r+1, c) and not isbg(r+1, c+1)]
    corners = set()
    for br, bc in blocks:
        for dr in (0, 1):
            for dc in (0, 1):
                corners.add((br+dr, bc+dc))
    for (r, c) in list(corners):
        col = g[r][c]
        for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1), (-1, 1), (-1, -1)):
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and g[nr][nc] == col and (nr, nc) not in corners:
                rr, cc = r+dr, c+dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and (g[rr][cc] == bg or g[rr][cc] == col):
                    if g[rr][cc] == bg:
                        g[rr][cc] = col
                    rr += dr; cc += dc
    return g
'''
